name: The Sheep that wanted to fly
source:
What if an ordinary unnamed sheep envies an unnamed blackbird and wishes to be a bird? The sheep will meet an unnamed magician girl who will make its wish come true. But watch out, little sheep, you may fall of the tree!

[From [url=https://fflo.itch.io/sheep-o2a2]Itch.io[/url]]
